name: Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited
about: Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited engages in the ship building and repair, fabrication, heavy engineering, engineering infrastructure and services, shut down maintenance projects, and precision machining in India. The company was formerly known as L. P. Naval and Engineering Limited and changed its name to Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited in January 2021. Laxmipati Engineering Works Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Surat, India.
